cands.name: Farmer Helfrich
cands.bio: Democrat, 63. Sustainable and regenerative farmer (The Giving Farm / Here On The Farm) who teaches regenerative agriculture in his community. Ran against Taylor Yarkosky for HD 25 in 2022 and lost (Yarkosky 66%).
cands.local_ties: Native Floridian living in South Lake County, per his campaign site.

cands.name: Taylor Yarkosky
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, 49, Clermont business owner. Born in Albia, Iowa; attended University of Iowa. HD 25 representative since Nov 2022, now in his second term.
cands.local_ties: Clermont, Lake County (Florida Politics); born in Iowa (Wikipedia).

record.text: Voted for the six-week abortion limit and to place the property tax amendment on the November ballot (ClickOrlando guide).
Chairs the political committee Lake County Conservatives (2022 reporting).

money_notes.text: In 2022 he chaired the political committee Lake County Conservatives, which funded a mailer responding to attack mailers from American Future Fund and the state committee Making a Better Tomorrow.

controversies.text: Yarkosky was arrested for driving under the influence in 2004 and 2005, when he was in his twenties. During his 2022 House campaign he wrote that he regretted putting others in danger and had not had a drink in years. Opposition mailers had raised the arrests.

endorsements.text: Mike Haridopolos and Steve Crisafulli endorsed him in the 2022 primary.

cands.gaps: Current-cycle donors and endorsements not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
